d:
Kashi tamil sangmam 5.0 — do samriddh sanskritiyon, paranpraon aur bhashaon ka aitihasik mahasangam
28 navanbar se 12 disanbar 2026 tak aayojit hone vale is 15 divsiy bhavy aayojan men sakshi banen tamilnadu aur kashi ke sadiyon purane aatmiy aur sanskritik sanbandhon ke. shiksha mantralay dvara aayojit is vishesh sanskaran ki thim sant tiruvalluvar ki amar kriti 'thirukkural' par aadharit hai.
